intellect.name: intellect
intellect.desc: One born with this day pillar will excel in school and have high mental processing powers.

strategist.name: strategist
strategist.desc: One born with this day pillar will be masterminds in planning and execution.

smartTen.name: smartTen
smartTen.desc: One born with this day pillar will possess clear and flexible minds.

fortuneNoble.name: fortuneNoble
fortuneNoble.desc: Life will have fame and fortune. One will live long and prosperous.

dayNoble.name: dayNoble
dayNoble.desc: Kind and ethical. Follows the rules. [Ideal if Direct Wealth, Eating God, or Resource]

dayVirtue.name: dayVirtue
dayVirtue.desc: Understands the problems of others. Good at commuincating emotions and connecting with friends.

advancement.name: advancement
advancement.desc: Strives towards results and action.  Progresses with stability. Decisive and independent.

retreat.name: retreat
retreat.desc: Prone to setbacks, career hindrance. Slow to progress. Requires more work than average.

solitaryPhoenix.name: solitaryPhoenix
solitaryPhoenix.desc: Difficulty with relationships, due to Companion star found in Day Branch.

redLight.name: redLight
redLight.desc: One with red light pillars often have problems with stable relationships.  The effect is greatest if this pillar is found in the Day.

yinYangMismatch.name: yinYangMismatch
yinYangMismatch.desc: The effects are stronger if this pillar is found in the Day. In the old days, a chart with more than one such pillar tend towards arranged marriages.

commander.name: commander
commander.desc: One who posesses this pillar has the ability to achieve enormous success due to their ambitious nature.  These people possess high degrees of drive and forward-looking motivations.  The effect is greatest if this pillar is found in the Day.

nobleman.name: nobleman
nobleman.desc: Helpful person in your life – one who will lift you out of troubles. The most auspicious star, especially if found in natal chart.

saltPool.name: saltPool
saltPool.desc: Lust, attraction, charisma.  Internal romance if found in year/month.  External romance if found in day/hour.

intelligence.name: intelligence
intelligence.desc: Intuition, pattern recognition, fast learning. Also known as Intelligence Star.

thriving.name: thriving
thriving.desc: Filled with energy, encouraged to succeed.  If Weak DM: success comes easily.  If Strong DM: easy to be lazy.

goatBlade.name: goatBlade
goatBlade.desc: Bravery and courage. Intense with strong motivations. This is a Companion star; therefore, brings confidence to ego. Works well with 7Killings to achieve greatness. Prone to injuries due to aggressive nature.

redChamber.name: redChamber
redChamber.desc: Passion, lust, infidelity, affairs, romance. [Most relevant if in Day Branch]

studyRoom.name: studyRoom
studyRoom.desc: Knowledge, studies, learning, persistence. Also known as Literacy.

flyingSword.name: flyingSword
flyingSword.desc: Things move fast. Prone to surprising consequences.

goldCarriage.name: goldCarriage
goldCarriage.desc: Easily meet a partner who brings wealth or support. Good, proper relationships with others. [Ideally a wealth star with Day Branch being Useful God]

rightMeasure.name: rightMeasure
rightMeasure.desc: Respect for others.  Follows guidelines and laws.

wealthStorage.name: wealthStorage
wealthStorage.desc: Able to keep and save money.

skyWealth.name: skyWealth
skyWealth.desc: Prosperity. Enhanced if found in Luck or Annual Pillar. Ideal if Strong DM.

redMatchmaker.name: redMatchmaker
redMatchmaker.desc: Bright future, enhances positive aura. Positive surroundings and happy events.

elegantSeal.name: elegantSeal
elegantSeal.desc: Artistic talents, creative productions. Enhanced learning capabilities, especially if it is a Resource.

general.name: general
general.desc: Capable of leading an organization to success. Can spread influence.

peachBlossom.name: peachBlossom
peachBlossom.desc: Charisma, appearance, aura.  Easily attract others.

bloodBlade.name: bloodBlade
bloodBlade.desc: Prone to accidents, mishaps, falls, cuts, surgeries.

solitude.name: solitude
solitude.desc: Preference to be alone. Can self-reflect. Good for pondering. Dislikes big groups of people.

lonely.name: lonely
lonely.desc: Philosophical, spiritual, can gain enlightenment. Prefers to be alone.

funeralGate.name: funeralGate
funeralGate.desc: Prone to attracting energies from funerals, hospitals, and spirits.

robbery.name: robbery
robbery.desc: Impatient, difficult to deal with. Attracts others who are intense and demanding. Possible betrayal by friends.

separateEdge.name: separateEdge
separateEdge.desc: Disputes and entanglements. Possible separation from society.

deathGod.name: deathGod
deathGod.desc: Dedicated to work, attention to detail. If useful star: power and fame.  If not useful star: shallow, spendthrift. Possibly cause harm to others.

heavenRelief.name: heavenRelief
heavenRelief.desc: Protection, even if one has done something wrong. "Get out of jail" card.

heavenHappiness.name: heavenHappiness
heavenHappiness.desc: Forward-looking, positive outlook on life. Will not involve in trivial or petty disagreements. Will live a joyful life.

heavenVirtueNoble.name: heavenVirtueNoble
heavenVirtueNoble.desc: Strong, fatherly figure of protection. One is earnest and focused.

monthlyVirtueNoble.name: monthlyVirtueNoble
monthlyVirtueNoble.desc: Soft, motherly figure of protection. One is considerate and generous.

monthEmptiness.name: monthEmptiness
monthEmptiness.desc: Wandering for direction in life, uncertain about one's future path.

fiveProsperity.name: fiveProsperity
fiveProsperity.desc: Symbolizes wealth, fortune, and probability of a good political career.

thrivingDay.name: thrivingDay
thrivingDay.desc: Energy and persistence to break through obstacles.

dragonVirtue.name: dragonVirtue
dragonVirtue.desc: Ethical, noble, able to attract mentors and helpful people.

goldLock.name: goldLock
goldLock.desc: Expert in an industry. Brilliance in career aspects. Strong decision-making abilities.

skyDog.name: skyDog
skyDog.desc: Physical scars and injuries, easily gets hurt.

hook.name: hook
hook.desc: Prone to gossip, rumors, social, and legal troubles.

bigDelight.name: bigDelight
bigDelight.desc: Inauspicious. Lack of harmony. Discord among people. Fierce negative energy.

fiveGhost.name: fiveGhost
fiveGhost.desc: Prone to gossip, undesired annoyance from negative people.

peachBlossom.name: peachBlossom
peachBlossom.desc: Charisma, appearance, aura.  Easily attract others.

bloodBlade.name: bloodBlade
bloodBlade.desc: Prone to accidents, mishaps, falls, cuts, surgeries.

skyDipper.name: skyDipper
skyDipper.desc: One is aligned with the natural order of things.

yearBreaker.name: yearBreaker
yearBreaker.desc: Money comes, money goes.  Finds it hard to save money.

calamitySha.name: calamitySha
calamitySha.desc: Prone to bodily injuries, minor illness.

sickness.name: sickness
sickness.desc: Prone to illness, worry, anxiety. Should take care of health and visit hospitals less often.

fortuneVirtue.name: fortuneVirtue
fortuneVirtue.desc: Positivity and protection from the upper realm. Ethical and proper behavior.

whiteTiger.name: whiteTiger
whiteTiger.desc: Traffic accidents, legal troubles, body injury, volatile ups and downs.

moon.name: moon
moon.desc: Powerful energy to drive forward and accomplish goals. Step-by-step support to gain wealth and success.

sun.name: sun
sun.desc: Inauspicious things turn auspicious. Negativity can be avoided.

grandDuke.name: grandDuke
grandDuke.desc: Also know as the Tai Sui, this star is identical to the year pillar branch. Resonates strong energy and represents the planet of Jupiter.
